contract.cancellation_text: CANCELLATION POLICY: FIT (1 TO 9 ROOMS) – 48 hours prior to arrival: Will be subjected to 100% of the total reservation value. contract.payment_text: All payments to be made strictly prior to the arrival of clients or until credit are approved from our Credit Department. Payments in full require to be made 3 days prior to the arrival date. Please be kind enough to inform credit managers for individual hotels when the transfer is done on E-mail. Credit manager: Cinnamon Lakeside – Mr. Dinesh Tissera, 071 645 0276, dineshti@cinnamonhotels.com.
contract.terms_text: TACTICAL RATES – Cinnamon Hotels Colombo partner with the Operator on a non-exclusive basis (FIT, GIT & MICE). Rates are valid until END MARCH 2026 only and subject to change with prior notice [as printed; the period header says 1ST OCT 2026 TO 31ST MAR 2027]. ALL ABOVE RATES GIVEN ARE FOR PACKAGED PRODUCTS AND RATES MUST NOT BE SOLD AS STANDALONE ACCOMMODATION OR DIRECT BOOKINGS. Rates are NON-Commissionable and are Inclusive of prevailing service charge and applicable taxes. Presently 10% Service Charge, 18% VAT, 1.01% Tourist Development Tax & 2.5% SSCL (subject to change). All meals are served at the designated hotel restaurants as mentioned above. Buffet rates given are for packaging purposes and to be sold to residential guests only. | MICE RATE (not entered as a rate – no MICE tier): 01 Oct 2026 – 31 Mar 2027 Superior BB SGL 80 / DBL 90 / TPL 117. | MEAL SUPPLEMENT AT THE DINING ROOM RESTAURANT (1 / 2 / 3 persons): Breakfast 12 / 24 / 36; Lunch 20 / 40 / 60; Dinner 24 / 48 / 72. | CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT: Check-In time is 14:00hrs & Check-out time is 12 noon. Guaranteed access to rooms prior to 14:00hrs requires pre-registration from the night before; at contracted rate. Early check-in between 00:00hrs – 10:00hrs, 100% of accommodation cost on basis booked (Subject to availability). Early check-in between 10:00hrs – 14:00hrs, 50% of accommodation cost on basis booked (Subject to availability). Late check-out 50% of accommodation cost on basis booked (Subject to availability) till 18:00hrs. Beyond 1800Hrs 100% of accommodation cost on basis booked (Subject to availability). | CONTACTS: Reservations Manager Mr. Muneeb Ahamed 77 531 0969, muneeb@cinnamonhotels.com. ROOM AVAILABILITY: "HELLO by Cinnamon" WhatsApp tool 071 216 1161 (https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=94712161161). Cinnamon Lakeside Reservations 71 875 6963, travel.lakeside@cinnamonhotels.com; Lobby Manager (24/7) 71 703 5750, lobbymanager.lakeside@cinnamonhotels.com. Signed for Cinnamon Colombo Hotels by Shaun Ricardo Windsor, Assistant Director of Sales (Leisure); no date printed. | RATE PARITY (separate letter "Cinnamon Hotel Management Limited - Rate Parity - City Properties (1).pdf", Cinnamon Hotel Management Limited, effective 28th March 2024, signed Imran Noordeen; no rates): all static rates only as part of a bundle/package with at least one other substantial travel component (airfare, round trip accommodation or local logistics); never room-only / unpackaged, never on OTAs, opaque, group-buying, flash-sale, social-commerce or daily-deal sites, never through any GDS; never disclose the rate to the guest or claim lowest/discounted/exclusive prices; rates not to be transferred to other companies except B2B contractors; the operator is responsible for leaks by its sub-contractors. Best Rate Guarantee: non-compliance must be rectified within 24 hours of written notice or inventory is withheld (recurring: access discontinued); on a guest's Best Rate Guarantee claim the operator settles the difference (incl. value additions) within 15 days. A signed acknowledgement of the letter is requested.
contract.notes: Transcribed from "Cinnamon Hotels Colombo - TACTICAL RATE (1).pdf" (4 pages), saved to the winter RTS folder on 2 Oct 2026. Two printed periods, each with a "FIT & GIT" and a "MICE" table (Superior room, Bed and Breakfast, SGL / DBL / TPL per room per night). Entered: 1 Oct 2026 – 31 Mar 2027 FIT & GIT, as a tactical plan (priority 10, tier all), October 2026 included as printed. NOT entered: 3 Jul – 30 Sep 2026 (ended) – FIT & GIT 80 / 85 / 112, MICE 80 / 80 / 107; and the MICE rate of the current period (80 / 90 / 117) because the system has no MICE tier – quote MICE groups by hand. The T&C line says "valid until END MARCH 2026" – a year typo against the period header; entered to 31 Mar 2027 (confirm). No booking window or rate code printed (W13). Higher categories, meal supplements, child policy, check-in/out and payment are printed as on the winter contract (except Cilantro Suite: +130 here, +150 on the contract); cancellation is shorter (FIT 48 hours). This tactical rate is lower than the winter contract (rts_cin_lakeside) and covers the whole contract period, so it wins every night while both are approved. No gala dinner printed (W06). Not covered: Cinnamon Red.
